verdicts.why: Hope van Dyne is one of the survivor group and dies on the way in. On the train she blows up the infected Sharon Carter and is wounded in the blast. The infection spreads, and when the train stops outside Camp Lehigh she grows giant to carry the group through the horde, then dies and later comes back as a zombie. Wikipedia lists her with Hogan and Carter as lost to zombie attacks on the way there. The other survivors' losses are all listed, so leaving her out is a real omission. The proposed line is true, uses the [text, title] shape, and is tied to the right title. It is kind missing, so it does not count toward the owner's wrong-only bar.

John's death is tied to the wrong title. A bare string got in when an earlier accepted amend (dc/accepted.json n 24) wrote only the text into loss:1. In index.html, dcLines = L => L.filter(([, t]) => atlSeenT(t)) destructures the string, so t becomes 'o', its second character. 'o' is not a title, so the line never unlocks and never shows. Ironheart episode 3 confirms the fact: in the Heirlum heist, N.A.T.A.L.I.E. rescues Riri and John is left to suffocate. So pairing the line with 'Ironheart' is the right fix and the smallest one.
